## Load required libraries

```{r cars}

library(dplyr)
library(visdat)
library(readr)
#library(summarytools)
```



## Load the shipment dataset into R
```{r echo=FALSE}

shipment  <- readr::read_csv("shipment_Dataset.csv")

head(shipment, 10)
tail(shipment, 10)

View(shipment)
```
The shipment data set has `dim(shipment)` rows, columns


##Descriptive Analysis
```{r}
#Showing the statistics of the shipment dataset
summary(shipment)


#Showing the structure of the shipment dataset
str(shipment)

#visual display of datatype
visdat::vis_dat(shipment)

```

Rows: 2508 Columns: 17 
The column names and types: `spec(shipment)`





## Clean dataset
```{r echo=FALSE}

visdat::vis_miss(shipment)




```
